analytic_reference.feasibility_proof: For <=5 distinct positive nodes, multiply each column of [1/lambda,1,lambda,lambda^2,lambda^3] by lambda. The resulting powers0..4 have full column rank by the Vandermonde determinant. Thus no nonzero weight difference exists on <=5 nodes; six is the minimum support union, not the support size of each target.
